# Highlights Morocco Tours

> Highlights Morocco Tours is a private tour operator based in Morocco. It organises tailor-made multi-day tours and day trips across the country, with private drivers, expert local guides, Sahara desert camps and Marrakech riads. Guides speak English and Spanish.

Website: https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/
Email: info@highlightsmoroccotours.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +212 668 561 321
Base: Marrakech, Morocco

## About

Meet Moha, from the Moroccan desert. Highlights Morocco Tours is based in Marrakech and builds every trip around the travellers' dates, pace and interests, with a private driver and a local guide who speaks English or Spanish, plus 24/7 assistance while in Morocco.

## What we offer

- Private Morocco tours: tailor-made itineraries at your own pace, with a private driver.
- Day trips in Morocco.
- Authentic Sahara experiences: camel trekking, Berber culture and nights under the stars.
- Stays in Marrakech riads and Merzouga luxury desert camps.
- Safe travel: licensed local drivers, expert guides and 24/7 assistance.

## Departure cities

- Tours from: Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Rabat, Tangier, Errachidia.
- Day trips from: Marrakech, Fes, Ouarzazate, Merzouga.

## How to book

Request a free quote through the website or by email or WhatsApp. Prices and itineraries are confirmed in the quote.
